name: beacon-semiprime
description: Fresh 16-digit semiprimes derived from the drand quicknet beacon, verifiable by anyone

scripts.test: node test/vectors.mjs > /tmp/bs-js.out && python3 verify.py --vectors | python3 -c "import sys,json;[print(json.dumps(json.loads(l),separators=(',',':'))) for l in sys.stdin]" > /tmp/bs-py.out && node -e "const f=require('fs');const a=f.readFileSync('/tmp/bs-js.out','utf8').trim().split('\n').map(JSON.parse);const b=f.readFileSync('/tmp/bs-py.out','utf8').trim().split('\n').map(JSON.parse);if(JSON.stringify(a)!==JSON.stringify(b)){console.error('JS and Python derivations DIFFER');process.exit(1)}console.log('JS and Python derivations agree on',a.length,'vectors')"
